endpoint_eligibility.brier_score: development-only after a source-blind calibrator is fit without the evaluated source
endpoint_eligibility.held_source_auprc: eligible as nested development cross-source recovery only after all leakage gates pass
endpoint_eligibility.open_champion: ineligible because datasets_sealed is empty and the executable promotion gate permits only blocked_missing_sealed_source

current_coloc_gwas.allowed_use: Outer-training typed graph evidence only after the corrected 50-study COLOC release is promoted. Native-build LD and locus grouping precede graph construction.
current_coloc_gwas.warning: Current memberships are exposed and provisional; no local checkpoint may be created from them before promotion.

gse281160.allowed_use: Development-only source-recovery diagnostic. Same-cell guide and RNA observations are aggregated to experimental replicate, target locus, and guide family before typed edges are constructed.
gse281160.topology: same_cell guide and RNA; cells and guides are not biological replicates
gse281160.warning: The 20 targets were MPRA-selected and are not an unbiased source seal.

gse281364.allowed_use: Development-only source-recovery diagnostic grouped by locus and sequence identity. MPRA reporter activity is not an endogenous enhancer-gene relation without an independent frozen link.
gse281364.topology: same_sample_different_aliquot DNA and RNA counts; 16 experimental replicates

gse289173.allowed_use: none for the typed-evidence graph task under the current TaskSpec
gse289173.reason: It is not a registered graph seal and its QTL outcomes cannot be imported to create one.

resource_gene_catalog_current.allowed_use: Exposed development graph content only after a promoted immutable snapshot. Resource evidence classes, thresholds, hero genes, and frozen programs remain authoritative and cannot be optimized as model targets.

held_source_protocol.calibration: Fit any probability calibrator using predictions and labels from remaining source-held development folds only. The evaluated source contributes no calibration row, prevalence, threshold, or class weight.
held_source_protocol.decoder: Train one source-agnostic candidate-gene head. Do not instantiate or query a held-source-specific edge-type output.
held_source_protocol.graph_removal: Before metadata or HeteroData construction, delete every held-source edge, inverse edge, source node, provenance field, assay-observability mask, derived path, aggregate, degree, source count, feature, normalization statistic, and duplicate alias.
held_source_protocol.metadata_rule: The frozen schema may reserve a semantic type name for reporting, but no untrained held edge-type parameter can be used at inference. The model input edge_index_dict contains only remaining-source types.
held_source_protocol.negative_sampling: Generate training negatives separately within each remaining source's eligible tested universe. Untestable, not-applicable, structurally missing, join-unresolved, or absent edges are not negatives.
held_source_protocol.node_universe: Construct variants, loci, and genes from source-independent registries frozen before source removal. A node, type, or candidate introduced only because the held source assayed it is evaluator-only.
held_source_protocol.split: Group native-build LD blocks, loci, source aliases, genes, and deterministic derivatives before graph construction. Remove held-locus incident edges and a frozen message-passing neighborhood where required.
held_source_protocol.success_interpretation: Remaining typed evidence can prioritize genes later supported by the removed source. Attention weights are not mechanistic explanations or causal effects.

induction_contract.feature_lane: Conditionally inductive to unseen nodes of existing node types only when features are produced by frozen source-independent transforms and all incident relation types were trained.
induction_contract.transductive_lane: Permitted only as an explicitly labeled fixed-node-universe development comparator. Node existence and features cannot derive from the held source.

missingness_and_semantics.missingness_rule: No missing, untested, unavailable, or held evidence state is encoded as a zero-valued negative edge.
missingness_and_semantics.native_operator_gap: HGTConv accepts edge triplets but no continuous per-edge features. Binning evidence strength into extra types can multiply parameters and leak source identity; any such design requires a frozen development-only justification.
missingness_and_semantics.scientific_language: Use colocalized or genetically anchored candidate and prioritization. Never causal gene from COLOC or graph rank alone.

reproducibility_contract.graph_receipt: Hash promoted input rows, canonical node IDs and types, ordered edge triplets, inverse edges, source provenance, explicit missing states, removed-source list, and every derivative feature before fitting.
reproducibility_contract.local_artifact: Freeze architecture, metadata order, graph receipt, outer role, decoder, negatives, calibration folds, seed, environment, tensors, and predictions for every model.
reproducibility_contract.statistical_unit: independent locus; seeds, attention heads, edges, variants, genes, guides, and cells are not independent biological replicates
